## Downloads
Every file below is covered by `decaid-0.8.1-SHA256SUMS.txt`.
- **macOS** — `decaid-macos-0.8.1.dmg` (signed and notarized; drag Decaid to Applications). The `decaid-macos-0.8.1.zip` remains the portable build used for auto-update. - **Windows x64** — `decaid-windows-x64-0.8.1.zip` (portable; extract the whole ZIP and run `Decaid.exe`; the build is unsigned). - **Linux x86_64** — `decaid-linux-x86_64-0.8.1.AppImage` (chmod +x and run; no installation needed). - **Linux ARM64** — `decaid-linux-aarch64-0.8.1.AppImage`. - **Linux portable archives** — `decaid-linux-x64-0.8.1.tar.gz` and `decaid-linux-arm64-0.8.1.tar.gz`. - **Android** — `decaid-android-0.8.1.apk`. **iOS** — unsigned `decaid-ios-unsigned-0.8.1.ipa`.
**Stable URLs** — every file above also ships as a `-latest` alias, so `https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/releases/latest/download/decaid-android-latest.apk` (and `decaid-macos-latest.dmg`, `decaid-linux-x86_64-latest.AppImage`, ...) always points at the newest stable release. The aliases are covered by `decaid-latest-SHA256SUMS.txt`.
See `doc/RELEASE.md` for install and verification instructions.
